description: Uploads a local picture (PNG, JPEG, WebP), video (MP4, MOV, WebM) or audio file (MP3, WAV, M4A, AAC, OGG) as base64 bytes (up to 10 MB) so it can be attached immediately as a reference to picture_make or clip_make. Spends no tokens.

data_base64.description: Raw file bytes encoded as base64 (without data: prefix).

mime.description: MIME type (image/png, image/jpeg, image/webp, video/mp4, audio/mpeg, etc.).

name.description: Original file name (e.g. product.png, clip.mp4, voice.mp3).

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.

name: create_ref_upload
title: Upload a reference file
